root_cause.detail: The v0.1 runner executed `gh api` under ErrorActionPreference=Stop while probing whether the remote raw-result path existed. The expected HTTP 404 for an absent file surfaced as a terminating error before the explicit LASTEXITCODE handling could interpret absence.

repair.strategy: Pinned v0.1 is patched in-memory only at the two GitHub existence probes. The probe is isolated through Start-Process and interprets HTTP 404/Not Found as ABSENT while treating other nonzero failures as fatal.

truth_boundary: No FLUX generation occurred. Local image editing remains NOT_VERIFIED_RUNTIME. The explicit one-shot scope remains bounded to the same Base/B1/B2 benchmark; recurrence, persistence, installs, downloads, paid APIs and additional generations remain unauthorized.
